children: abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund launched a transferable rights offering and entered three supporting agreements to execute the capital raise. The fund appointed UBS Securities, alongside abrdn and abrdn Investments, as dealer manager; engaged Equiniti as subscription agent; and retained EQ Fund Solutions as information agent. Record date shareholders as of Sep 21, 2026 receive one right per share, exercisable for one new share for every three rights, with an oversubscription privilege, for up to 10,545,755 new shares. The agreements are intended to streamline distribution, processing and shareholder communications throughout the offering period.
